fact: Libya's Ministry of Technical and Vocational Education states its Informatics and Documentation Department, through its Information Systems Section, is overseeing the update project of the ministry's electronic archiving system, developed from feedback by users across the ministry's offices; the document's published date 2026-09-23 is used as it gives no other date.
The General Information Authority thanked its own engineer and technical team who designed and developed the updated tenders platform, which went live.
